build_bart_model: build a BART model using the BARTModel class with encoder and decoder components
create_classification_head: create a BARTClassificationHead for sentence-level classification tasks with configurable inner dimensions
register_classification_head: register a new classification head on a BART model for downstream classification tasks
load_bart_from_pretrained: load a pretrained BART model from the hub using from_pretrained with model name
configure_bart_architecture: configure BART architecture using bart_large_architecture or bart_base_architecture registry functions
